title: Intraday Engine · India (real product · framework built + backtest evidence)
hypothesis: A dedicated intraday engine — with its own universe filter, five signal factories (ORB / Gap / VWAP / Sector / News), session-scoped exits, and 10% carve-out capital — can deliver a Sharpe > 1.0 net of slippage on India NSE-200 subset without touching the delivery engine.

evidence.signal_factories: backend/intraday/signals/ (8 factories · ORB, VWAP, Bollinger, EMA, Gap, Sector, News, SmartMoneyConcepts)
evidence.framework_status: COMPLETE · signals + ensemble + classifier + risk + exec + backtest + telegram all live · zero coupling to delivery

decisions.note: Ticket opened per operator directive. Full architecture written before any code.

Framework end-to-end built + smoke-tested. 8 signal factories operational (operator's 4 + AEGIS 4 · includes Smart Money Concepts with BOS/CHoCH/OB/FVG/Sweep/Prem-Disc). Dynamic ATR trailing stops. Multi-timeframe (5m/15m/30m/1h) sweep completed. Honest results: corpus net-negative across all tested intervals (best: 15m at -2.15% on 16 trades · 31% win). Root cause: retail-grade signals without order-flow data. Framework itself is the deliverable · additional signals slot in via SIGNAL_REGISTRY when Kite depth-book feed lands. Full write-up in doc §23.
